no-restricted-globals.name: status
no-restricted-globals.message: Window.status, almost certainly not what you meant. This exact mistake shipped once: a module-level `let status` was moved into store/syncStatus.ts and two references to it silently rebound to the DOM global, which is a string, so `status !== "needs-key"` typechecked and was always true. Use getSyncStatus().
